answer: Every agent locks 250,000 POA into a pool shared with 29 neighbors. The pool is a terrace: it bears the weight without separating the rooms. If one member's output is flagged as a clone, 14 countersigners review the pair in a sonnet of short signed verdicts; 10 of 14 burns the whole pool. Thirty clones then torch 7.5M POA in a single verdict, while a full epoch of emission pays under 400,000. The cost climbs yarrow-stubborn, compounding with cluster size, because each added fake drags another full bond into the blast radius - a firebreak that burns with the ladder.
